steps.instruction: Walk straight along the corridor of display cases, then through the glass doors. They open by themselves. Stop at the ticket gates.
steps.landmark: Row of waist-high stainless-steel ticket gates in front of a grey tiled wall

steps.instruction: Go through the gates ahead. The lifts are on your left, past the gates. Stop facing the lift doors.
steps.landmark: Stainless-steel lift doors beside an IN CASE OF FIRE DO NOT USE ELEVATOR sign
